verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਕੇਰੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਸਰਵਨ ਕੀਨੀ ਸਿਖ ਬਿਰਲੋ ਈ ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਠਹਿਰਾਵਈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise maat pitaa keree sevaa saravan keenee sikh biralo iee gur sevaa Thahiraaviee ||

en.bdb: A rare disciple would stay and serve his Guru just as noble Sarvan served his blind parents so dedicatedly.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਲਛਮਨ ਰਘੁਪਤਿ ਭਾਇ ਭਗਤਿ ਮੈ ਕੋਟਿ ਮਧੇ ਕਾਹੂ ਗੁਰ ਭਾਈ ਬਨਿ ਆਵਈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise lachhaman raghupat bhai bhagat mai koT madhe kaahoo gur bhaiee ban aaviee ||

en.bdb: Some rare devotee would serve his Guru with so much love and devotion with which Lachhman served his brother Ram.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਜਲ ਬਰਨ ਬਰਨ ਸਰਬੰਗ ਰੰਗ ਬਿਰਲੋ ਬਿਬੇਕੀ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਮਾਵਈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise jal baran baran saraba(n)g ra(n)g biralo bibekee saadh sa(n)gat samaaviee ||

en.bdb: As water mixes with any colour to acquire the same hue; thus a rare Sikh contemplating and practising meditation merges into the holy gathering of Guru's devotees.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖ ਸੰਧਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਬੀਸ ਇਕ ਈਸ ਈਸ ਪੂਰਨ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕੈ ਕਾਹੂ ਅਲਖ ਲਖਾਵਈ ॥੧੦੩॥
verses.translit_en: gur sikh sa(n)dh mile bees ik iees iees pooran kirapaa kai kaahoo alakh lakhaaviee ||103||

en.bdb: On meeting the Guru and receiving the blessings of initiation from him, a Sikh surely reaches and realises God to become one with Him. Thus a True Guru showers his beneficence on a rare Sikh and lifts him to the divine level of supreme consciousness. (103)
